name: Limits of Statistical Assurance
summary: Characterises the limits of finite safety assessment against an adversary that preserves unattacked behaviour until certification, and evaluates monitoring with permanent revocation in simulated collaboration and agent benchmarks.
numbers: RoCo collaboration: violations in 34 of 36 post-certification episodes; monitoring 12.00→3.81 per 24 tasks, at a cost in tasks done

why.xr: Evaluation-gaming and certification failure, with a strong assumed adversary.
